name: Repast Suite
description: Family of open-source agent-based modelling (ABM) platforms developed at Argonne National Laboratory, encompassing Repast Simphony (Java), Repast4Py (Python), and the legacy Repast HPC for high-performance computing. The suite supports building, running, and analysing complex adaptive systems across scales from desktop experiments to HPC clusters.
reputation: One of the most widely used and long-standing ABM frameworks in academic and government research; benchmark of reference for large-scale social and biological simulations.
notes: Not an evaluation benchmark but a modelling toolkit; performance is assessed through model validity, reproducibility, and scalability metrics. Repast Simphony has a separate card.
